purpose: Create a non-destructive original-layout coordinate layer for TC001 glyph binding. This file does not contain downloaded artwork and does not publish derivative crops.

sourceFacts.layoutPolicy: Preserve the historical 28-line irregular layout. Reject modern 27 x 12 or other normalized reflows as spatial evidence.

是.textAnchor: 暢敘幽情。是日也。天朗氣清
是.rule: Do not infer a coordinate from a reflowed transcription.

和.textAnchor: 天朗氣清。惠風和暢。仰觀宇宙
和.rule: Retain 惠風和暢 as the minimum contextual crop once image binding exists.

bindingProcedure: Resolve an image representation that demonstrably preserves the original 28-line Shenlong layout.
Register the whole writing field in normalized 0..1 coordinates before selecting individual glyphs.
Identify line boundaries first; never locate a glyph by freehand pixel guess.
Bind text anchors to line IDs and retain a full-line region.
Only then derive normalized glyph bounding boxes for 是 and 和.
Measure relative scale, center of gravity, lean, neighboring gap and line-axis offset from the same registered field.
Record entry/exit direction and implicit continuation as observations, with confidence and evidence notes.
Keep the source representation external; store only source reference, measurements and research annotations in this project unless separately admitted by the corpus rights gate.
researchNote: A modern digital recreation found during source discovery explicitly states that it regularizes the original 28 irregular lines into 27 lines of 12 characters. It is useful as a negative control only and must never enter spatial training.
